headline: Trump, Mamdani give contrasting July 4th speeches. And, U.S. faces Belgium in World Cup
context: For the nation's 250th birthday, President Trump and NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani had opposing visions of America. And, the U.S. and Belgium face off today in the FIFA World Cup.
